points.quote: Failure to reference the use of Gen AI, including the submission of work which is not a student’s own, will in all cases be considered a matter of Academic Misconduct.
points.gist: Failing to reference Gen AI use, including submitting work that is not the student's own, is in all cases academic misconduct.

points.quote: It is for course teams – not individual staff members – to agree the type and level of use which is acceptable at different stages of the course.
points.gist: Course teams, not individual staff, agree the type and level of acceptable use at different stages of the course.

points.quote: These decisions must be conveyed explicitly to students, and confirmation of acceptable use should be included within assignment briefs.
points.gist: Decisions on acceptable use must be conveyed explicitly to students, and confirmed in assignment briefs.

points.quote: Students must not claim authorship of any work they did not produce (and must acknowledge any references).
points.gist: Students must not claim authorship of work they did not produce, and must acknowledge any references.

points.quote: Students must be clear that responsibility for content ultimately rests solely with themselves.
points.gist: Students must be clear that responsibility for content rests solely with themselves.

points.quote: any information produced cannot be treated as reliable or accurate. It may simply be wrong; but even an accurate response may be missing important factors, and it may not address specific cultural or social contexts.
points.gist: Information produced cannot be treated as reliable or accurate; it may be wrong, miss factors, or not address cultural or social contexts.

points.quote: AUB recognises that there is no fool-proof detection software for Gen AI. Even the best tools will identify “false positives”
points.gist: AUB recognises there is no fool-proof Gen AI detection software and even the best tools give false positives.

points.quote: In all cases, if academic misconduct of any form is suspected, the Academic Misconduct Policy should be used.
points.gist: If academic misconduct of any form is suspected, the Academic Misconduct Policy should be used.

points.quote: Staff will, on all courses, explain what Gen AI is, its benefits and limitations, and the use which is considered acceptable.
points.gist: Staff will explain on all courses what Gen AI is, its benefits and limitations, and what use is acceptable.

points.quote: It can also be used to simplify language and give grammatical feedback – checking spelling, grammar or sentence structure.
points.gist: Gen AI can be used to simplify language and give grammatical feedback on spelling, grammar or sentence structure.

points.quote: Some Gen AI tools generate reasonable reading lists (although in written text, they may produce references and lists of resources that do not exist/are false).
points.gist: Some Gen AI tools generate reasonable reading lists, though they may produce references and resources that do not exist.

points.quote: Information / digital literacy is a vital skill which will be introduced at Level 4 and will form an integral part of all courses.
points.gist: Information and digital literacy will be introduced at Level 4 and form an integral part of all courses.

points.quote: students might be asked to generate content and to offer a critique
points.gist: Students might be asked to generate content and offer a critique.
